name: Satya Ranjan Bakshi
contribution: Bakshi was a Hindu public figure who supported the 1947 proposal for an undivided, sovereign Bengal.
context: He participated in the political debate around the United Bengal plan, which sought to avoid the province’s division even as Congress and Muslim League positions hardened.
impact: His involvement shows that opposition to partition also existed among Hindu Bengali leaders, although the united-Bengal proposal did not prevail.
